mapper.sql: o.status = 'PAID' AND o.funding IN ('FREE','MOCK') AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.credits > 0 AND o.valid_days > 0 AND o.output_count > 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM purchase_payment p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND p.user_id = o.user_id AND p.paid_at = o.paid_at AND ( (o.funding = 'FREE' AND p.channel = 'FREE' AND p.amount = 0 AND p.simulated = 0) OR (o.funding = 'MOCK' AND p.channel = 'MOCK' AND p.amount = o.amount AND p.simulated = 1) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM entitlement_grant WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND item_key = #{itemKey}
SELECT * FROM entitlement_grant WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM entitlement_grant WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT NOW(3)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 'PAID' AND id > #{afterOrderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_outbox WHERE kind = 'ENTITLEMENT_GRANT' AND aggregate_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE entitlement_grant SET available_credits = available_credits - #{amount}, expired_credits = expired_credits + #{amount}, status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE id = #{id} AND available_credits = #{amount} AND expires_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE entitlement_grant SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at <= NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM entitlement_grant WHERE expires_at <= NOW(3) AND (status = 'ACTIVE' OR available_credits > 0) ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_credits), 0) AS total_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' OR expires_at <= NOW(3) THEN 0 ELSE available_credits END), 0) AS available_credits, COALESCE(SUM(frozen_credits), 0) AS frozen_credits, COALESCE(SUM(consumed_credits), 0) AS consumed_credits, COALESCE(SUM(expired_credits + CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' OR expires_at <= NOW(3) THEN available_credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expired_credits, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > NOW(3)), 0) AS active_grants, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'EXPIRED' OR expires_at <= NOW(3)), 0) AS expired_grants FROM entitlement_grant WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement_grant

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_outbox WHERE kind = 'ENTITLEMENT_GRANT' AND state = 'REVIEW'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_failure f WHERE f.consumer_group = 'entitlement-grants' AND (f.event_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM business_outbox o WHERE o.id = f.event_id AND o.state <> 'DONE' ))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement_grant WHERE status = 'EXPIRED' OR expires_at <= NOW(3)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order o WHERE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entitlement_grant g WHERE g.order_id = o.id AND g.item_key = 'credits' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM business_outbox t WHERE t.kind = 'ENTITLEMENT_GRANT' AND t.aggregate_id = o.id )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_outbox t WHERE t.kind = 'ENTITLEMENT_GRANT' AND t.state = 'DONE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entitlement_grant g WHERE g.order_id = t.aggregate_id AND g.item_key = 'credits' )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT order_id, item_key FROM entitlement_grant GROUP BY order_id, item_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement_grant WHERE total_credits <> available_credits + frozen_credits + consumed_credits + expired_credits

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement_grant g WHERE g.total_credits <> COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.delta_total) FROM entitlement_ledger l WHERE l.grant_id = g.id), 0) OR g.available_credits <> COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.delta_available) FROM entitlement_ledger l WHERE l.grant_id = g.id), 0) OR g.frozen_credits <> COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.delta_frozen) FROM entitlement_ledger l WHERE l.grant_id = g.id), 0) OR g.consumed_credits <> COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.delta_consumed) FROM entitlement_ledger l WHERE l.grant_id = g.id), 0) OR g.expired_credits <> COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.delta_expired) FROM entitlement_ledger l WHERE l.grant_id = g.id), 0) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entitlement_ledger l WHERE l.grant_id = g.id AND l.id = (SELECT MAX(l2.id) FROM entitlement_ledger l2 WHERE l2.grant_id = g.id) AND (l.total_after <> g.total_credits OR l.available_after <> g.available_credits OR l.frozen_after <> g.frozen_credits OR l.consumed_after <> g.consumed_credits OR l.expired_after <> g.expired_credits) )
